text_block_list.text:
"I want to learn how to brew delicious 
coffee." Manhattan Cafe agreed to grant 
Satono Diamond's request.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you today!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please... Let's brew some delicious 
coffee together.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The flavor of coffee changes depending on 
the plantation. ...The variety and the 
terroir have a massive impact.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Finding beans that match your taste is 
part of the fun... Please, take your time 
choosing...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So many...! It's hard to decide which one 
to pick.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
At times like that... blending them is a 
fine option. An uncharted world... You can 
create a cup tailored just for you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
An uncharted world... what a wonderful 
sound! I shall challenge myself with 
blending!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Honduras... A chocolate aroma with a hint 
of passion fruit flavor... This one too!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"That makes 10 kinds... Um, maybe you 
should stop around there—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? A new flavor might be born? I 
mean... that might be true, but..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
All right, this one too... and this one as 
well!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... My very own original blend♪ Down 
the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: *gulp*, *gulp*...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... The bitterness and acidity are 
clashing. This really isn't a very 
pleasant taste...!
choice_data_list: I guess this is a failure...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...With more varieties of beans, the 
flavor grows complex. Perhaps the distinct 
flavors of the beans are... clashing too 
fiercely.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see... Hmm. Now, how to keep the flavors 
from clashing...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There you are! An ally who can mediate 
between our tastes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! It's a field full of veggies!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Vegetables get stir-fried together in all 
kinds of mixes, or thrown into the same 
hot pot, don't they?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
There are teas made from roasted 
vegetables, after all, so maybe you could 
help mediate things between the coffees!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I agree with Satono-san.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
To overturn the very concept of coffee... 
the common sense of it... I never would 
have conceived of such an idea...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Cafe-san...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it will produce an interesting 
coffee. ...My "friend"... agrees as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you're right! I can't even imagine 
what kind of coffee it'll turn out to be 
either.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why I want to challenge 
myself... even if the coffee doesn't turn 
out delicious in the end...!"
choice_data_list: Before that, why not learn the basics?
Let's keep trying until it's delicious!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see... So we're starting by solidifying 
the fundamentals, then.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Understood... First I will master the 
basics, and leave the adventures for 
later.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright. Now all that's left is to 
pour the hot water! Ah... but maybe if I 
add these beans, too—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um, as for the recipe...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —Right! I need to pull myself together...!

Reining in her curiosity, Satono Diamond 
successfully brewed a delicious cup of 
coffee!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! Please look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Vegetable-infused coffee... it is 
complete. Spinach, bell peppers, and 
more... It is even a deep dark green.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The smell is a bit grassy, or rather... 
H-Here goes nothing!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: *gulp*, *gulp*...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"This... does not taste good at all...! 
Ahaha, ahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...That's true... Fufu.

Even if the taste was lackluster, it was a 
coffee that brought out smiles!
